query:
INSERT INTO note_links (id, source_id, target_id, target_raw, display_text)
             VALUES ($1, $2,
                     (SELECT id FROM notes
                      WHERE project_id = $3 AND (title = $4 OR permalink = $5)
                      LIMIT 1),
                     $6, $7)
             ON CONFLICT (source_id, target_raw) DO NOTHING
